opportunities.whenToUse: After a meaningful completion or first successful core action.
opportunities.whenToAvoid: Routine high-frequency saves, destructive flows, or serious compliance states.

opportunities.whenToUse: When the user needs encouragement and a clear first action.
opportunities.whenToAvoid: When missing data is an error or trust issue.

opportunities.whenToUse: When perceived progress, skeleton shape, or anticipation helps.
opportunities.whenToAvoid: When loading is instant or animation would mask slowness.

opportunities.whenToUse: First import, first export, first publish, streak, or meaningful threshold.
opportunities.whenToAvoid: Arbitrary vanity counters or fake-perfect metrics.

opportunities.whenToUse: Press, drag, reorder, reveal, or selection feedback.
opportunities.whenToAvoid: Controls used constantly or keyboard shortcuts.

opportunities.whenToUse: Recoverable, low-stakes errors where calm personality reduces stress.
opportunities.whenToAvoid: High-stakes failure, data loss, payment, health, legal, or security.

opportunities.whenToUse: Rare contextual moments after the main task remains clear.
opportunities.whenToAvoid: Any moment where discoverability or speed matters.
